- The yogurt appears mostly eaten.

Eaten: 540 − 40 = 500 kcal.

- Carbs: toast ~30 g, yogurt ~18 g, avocado ~5 g, milk ~2 g, so ~55 g.
- Fat: egg ~7 g, avocado ~11 g, toast ~4 g, yogurt ~3 g, milk ~1 g, so ~26 g.
